_**Agent (claude-opus-4-6 2026-03-04 06:40:20Z)**_

**Yes, it uses FreeRTOS directly and extensively.** The ESP32 Arduino framework includes FreeRTOS, and this project uses several FreeRTOS primitives in `src/main.cpp`:

- **Tasks**: `xTaskCreatePinnedToCore` — runs work on specific ESP32 cores
- **Queues**: `xQueueCreate`, `xQueueSend`, `xQueueReceive`, `uxQueueMessagesWaiting` — passes `CraftQueueItem` data between cores
- **Semaphores/Mutexes**: `xSemaphoreCreateMutex`, `xSemaphoreTake`, `xSemaphoreGive` — protects shared data (`freeListMutex`)
- **Delays/Yielding**: `vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(...))` — yields to the FreeRTOS scheduler throughout
